query:
SELECT s.id, s.title, s.artist, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.voteType = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as public_likes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.voteType = 'dislike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as public_dislikes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uv.voteType = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as user_likes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uv.voteType = 'dislike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as user_dislikes
FROM songs s
LEFT JOIN votes v ON s.id = v.songId
LEFT JOIN userVotes uv ON s.id = uv.songId
GROUP BY s.id, s.title, s.artist
HAVING (public_likes + public_dislikes + user_likes + user_dislikes) > 0
ORDER BY (public_likes + public_dislikes + user_likes + user_dislikes) DESC LIMIT 10;
